title: On detection of depression in Parkinson’s disease patients’ speech: handcrafted features vs. speech foundation models
core_idea: Compare two feature representation approaches for speech-based depression detection in Parkinson’s disease: interpretable handcrafted acoustic features versus non-interpretable representations from speech foundation models; examine viability of handcrafted features, analyze acoustic descriptor differences between typical (non-PD) and PD depression speech, and evaluate SFM-based representations using cross-validation layer selection on the PD-depression dataset.
tldr: The study aims to evaluate and compare handcrafted acoustic features and speech foundation model embeddings for detecting depression in Parkinson’s disease speech, and to analyze acoustic differences between typical and PD-related depression using DAIC-WOZ and PD-depression corpora.
